results.title: Algeria to send troops to Niger in first foreign deployment in over 50 years - France 24
results.snippet:
The incident triggered a diplomatic row, with Niger joining fellow junta-led allies Mali and Burkina Faso in recalling its ambassador from Algiers.

Algeria and Mali have since resumed diplomatic ties.

Niger has been run by General Abdourahamane Tiani since a July 2023 coup that toppled the elected president Mohamed Bazoum, who has been detained ever since.

(FRANCE 24 with AFP)
